Cardiff City vs Wrexham AFC Women selected for TV broadcast

Women's Team

16 hours ago

By Siôn Misra

Share

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Wrexham AFC Women’s Adran Premier game away against Cardiff City has been selected for live broadcast. 

The game, which will be live on S4C, will take place at Cardiff City Stadium on September 13 and kick-off at 5:15pm. It will be one week after the Red Dragons’ season opener against Aberystwyth Town at The Rock. 

Last time the two sides met in the capital, it was Wrexham who walked away with a 3-1 victory. A brace from Katie Barker coupled with a wonder goal from Faye Knox sealed an important three points for Jenny Sugarman’s side on their way to the title. 

Ticket information for the game will be released in due course.
